alexa.title: Connect with Alexa: before you start
alexa.description: Your PC remains paired with Home Assistant. Its power switch is `{entity_id}`. Matterbridge is a separate app; this guide does not install it or control your PC. Follow the [step-by-step Alexa guide]({guide_url}) before pressing Submit. The WakeLink pairing code is **not** the Matter QR code.

alexa_plugin.title: Connect Matterbridge to Home Assistant
alexa_plugin.description: Open **Settings > Apps > Matterbridge**; if it is missing, follow WakeLink's Matter preview guide to install the official app. Before installing `matterbridge-hass`, check that Matterbridge is **not already paired** with another controller: on first start the plugin may export every Home Assistant entity until filtered. If it is already paired, stop and configure safe filters first. In the plugin, use your actual Home Assistant WebSocket address: choose the secure `wss` scheme when Home Assistant serves HTTPS with a trusted certificate; use the unencrypted `ws` scheme only on a trusted local network because it sends the token without encryption. A Home Assistant long-lived access token is required; create it in your profile's Security page and paste it **only into the plugin's own interface**. This grants broad Home Assistant access; never enter it into WakeLink. Do not disable certificate validation for `wss`. Do not pair with Alexa yet.

alexa_filter.title: Expose only this PC's power switch
alexa_filter.description: In Home Assistant, create a label named `WakeLink Alexa` and apply it **only to the entity** `{entity_id}`, not to the whole device or area. In `matterbridge-hass`, set **Filter By Label** to exactly `WakeLink Alexa` and **Domain Whitelist** to `switch`. The label is the filter; an empty **Whitelist** by itself is not a filter. Save, restart the plugin and check Matterbridge **Devices**. Continue only if it shows exactly one device: this PC's power switch. If more devices appear, do not scan the Matter QR. Follow the linked step-by-step guide for every click.

alexa_pair.title: Pair with Alexa
alexa_pair.description: In Matterbridge **Settings > Matter settings**, set **Mdns interface** to the network interface shown in **Home Assistant > Settings > System > Network**; do not guess its name. Only after **Devices** shows your PC and no other exported devices, scan Matterbridge's Matter QR in the Alexa app with a compatible Echo on the same network. This is **not** WakeLink's six-digit PC code. Give the PC a distinct name. Finishing this guide does **not** verify Alexa. Check that the device appears first, and test shutdown only after saving your work.

abort.power_entity_missing: This PC's power switch is missing or disabled. Enable it in Home Assistant before connecting Alexa.
abort.guide_finished: Matter guide closed. The PC pairing is unchanged; verify Alexa separately.
